name: The Dirge-Wing
place: dungeon glass_tomb (Tomb of the Glass Kings, Glasswind Strand, level 14): mini-boss
_doc: A glasswing the old kings kept to sing at their burials, still singing. P1 "The Dirge": shard volleys (lines in a fan), a wing buffet, and a ringing note that only stops if you interrupt it (it hurts the whole room). P2 at 50% "Shatterwing": it breaks its own wings and the pieces fly as smaller glasswings; shards rain where they land.
party: Solo: save an interrupt for the note. 2-3: kill the small glasswings. 5: the fan of shards goes through crowds — spread.

pull: A high, clear note, like a wet finger round a glass rim.
Glass wings unfold in the dark, catching your torchlight.
say.death: The Dirge-Wing's last note cracks, and so does the Dirge-Wing.
say.reset: The Dirge-Wing folds its wings and goes back to singing quietly.

enrage.say: The Dirge-Wing's song becomes a shriek!

note.name: Ringing Note
note.say: The Dirge-Wing draws a long breath — interrupt the note!

shatter.name: Shatterwing
shatter.say: Pieces of its wings fly off and take wing themselves!

phases.name: Shatterwing
phases.say: The Dirge-Wing beats its wings until they break!
